finding.cause: docId sanitizes disallowed identifier characters to underscore. assignDocIds previously recognized collisions only when text differed; different raw identifiers with identical text therefore shared one document key and were not marked for stale-base-key pruning.
finding.fix: Preserve byte-exact legacy base+shortHash(rawText) IDs for single raw-identity groups with distinct texts. For every multi-identity group, use stable source-identity+normalized-text hashes regardless of text cardinality, tracking legacy text-hash aliases by base. The existing reindex path prunes a stale bare base or legacy alias only after every current replacement ID is confirmed in the index or successfully embedded; current assigned IDs are never alias-deleted.
finding.compatibility_limit: Historical single-identity different-text groups retain exact legacy text-hash keys. Multi-identity groups migrate old text-hash keys through guarded alias cleanup; cleanup remains deferred if any replacement is absent or fails embedding.
